Name: Small Town Rugs
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
[color=#f1f1f1]Someone in the SVE Discord server mentioned wanting a rug that appeared in front of Pierre's shop so I took the liberty of finding it and making it into its own placeable furniture item! It changes bi-seasonally so I added both.

(Apparently I missed these when doing my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29431]Stardew Furniture[/url] mod somehow)[/color]

This mod [i]adds[/i] them as furniture items it does not replace anything!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things[/b].

Manifest.Name: (CP) Small Town Rugs
Manifest.Description: Adds two rugs from the town to the game using Content Patcher!
